plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence — Option 1 published on catalog p. 139 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AS in Biology requires 33 major units plus GE. Option 1 is the track beginning with preparatory courses (CHEM 30A, MATH 1, MATH 50); Option 2 (separate plan, same degree) starts directly with CHEM 1A and MATH 3A for students who place higher. REQUIREMENT values 'Prereq for X'/'Coreq for X' mapped to major (major-preparation courses). 'Chem 3A' in the MATH 1/MATH 50 'Prereq for' labels appears to be a catalog typo (no CHEM 3A exists); MATH 3A's course description confirms its prerequisite as MATH 001 and MATH 050, which is what is coded. Unit ranges use the lower bound (MATH 1 '4 or 6' → 4; MATH 50 '3 or 4' → 3; ENGL 1A/1AS '4 or 5' → 4); Fall Y1 prints '19-23'. Footnote 1: BIOL 31 and COMM 1A may be taken during intersession if offered. Footnote 2: CHEM 1B and BIOL 1B may have to be taken at another Peralta (PCCD) college if not offered at COA. CHEM 1A also lists MATH 203 / Chemistry Assessment / ALEKS alternatives; the sequence's CHEM 30A path is coded. CHEM 30A, MATH 1, and MATH 50 catalog prerequisites (developmental math or placement) are assumed satisfied at entry for this track and are not coded. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
